sources.locator: "Battle of the Strait of Hormuz (1553)", revision 1370602416

explanation: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of the Strait of Hormuz (1553)" (revision 1370602416) says: "Piri Reis' attack on Muscat and Hormuz the previous year had triggered a Portuguese response from Goa, in the form of 30 galleons and caravels, 70 oar ships, and 3,000 soldiers commanded by the Viceroy himself, Dom Afonso de Noronha." The edge reads that sentence as: Battle of the Strait of Hormuz (1553) was a response to Ottoman campaign against Hormuz, and nothing more.
